name: Lyo.Avalonia.Components
tagline: Shared Avalonia controls for Lyo desktop apps.
description: Desktop apps share this library the way Blazor hosts share `Lyo.Web.Components`. `ToolDockBuilder` lays named panes around a center control on the left, right, or bottom. `ToolDockHit` picks the drop edge while a title bar is dragged. `ScreenEdgeDock` parks a window on the nearest screen edge. `EdgeDockBar` is the tab on that edge: the app sets its size, icon, and buttons, and handles click, double-click, hover, and drag. `AvaloniaDesktop.Configure` starts a desktop app with platform detection and the Inter font. `Tabber` is the shared tab strip: each page is parented once, and selecting a tab only shows that page.
features: **Tool windows.** `ToolDockState` records each pane's edge, visibility, and whether it is minimized. `ToolDockBuilder.Fill` stacks left and right panes vertically and bottom panes sideways, with splitters and a header the user can drag. Minimize collapses that pane to its header and shrinks the edge when every pane there is minimized. Close hides the pane; the host rebuilds from the changed callback.

**Screen edge.** `ScreenEdgeDock.Place` chooses the nearest edge from the window center and clamps the tab inside the work area. `Expand` grows the window inward. `Clamp` pulls an open tab back onto the screen without leaving its edge. `IconBias` shifts the icon toward a corner so turning onto the next edge does not throw it outward. `PulledOff` says when a drag has left the edge.

**Edge tab.** `EdgeDockBar` draws the icon and any number of buttons. `Thickness`, `Length`, and `Corner` set the shape. Hover opens the buttons, and leaving closes them. Click, double-click, and drag are events the app handles.
**Name and value.** `NameValueList` draws labeled rows. Play context, a captured request, and an element inspection share it.
**JSON.** `JsonEditor` shows a JSON document as a virtualized tree or as raw text. The tree searches, expands, collapses, colors values, and copies one node. A body that is not JSON stays as text.
**Tabs.** `Tabber` keeps each page parented once and only changes which page is visible. Headers can close, rename, and disable.

**Log.** `LogView` is a virtualized log fed by `LogSink`. Each row has a timestamp, a level chip, and the message. The toolbar filters by level and text, follows the tail, and copies or exports the visible lines.
